tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// gu ru drag po'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru bud+dha ya/ dmigs med chos dbyings dag pa bde ba can// rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i pho brang du// chos sku 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs// gdod ma'i gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i po ta lar// rang bzhin byin gyis brlabs pa'i pho brang du// longs sku spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs// 'od gsal rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs// 'gro 'dul phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa'i gnas// rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas// sprul sku thod phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs// 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par byin gyis rlobs// mi mngon ka nas dag pa gnas kyi mchog /spros bral lhun gyis grub pa'i mkha' spyod du// ma gcig ye shes mtsho rgyal la gsol ba 'debs// bde stong rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs// bskal par tshogs gnyis rgya cher 'phel ba'i zhing*// zab gter nyer lnga chos kyi pho brang du// rat+na gling pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro don rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs// bka' bab thugs rje brgyud 'dzin gnas kyi mchog /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa chos kyi rje// tshe dbang grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// nyams rtogs yon tan rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs// thugs kyi sgrub gnas nye ba'i tshan+dho ha// lho brag mkhar chu dpal gyi gter gnas su// yang gsang thugs sgrub nyid la gsol ba 'debs// bskyed rdzogs brtan pa thob par byin gyis rlobs// rtsa khams dag pa lus kyi pho brang du// thabs shes dbyer med zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku /yi dam pad+ma yab yum la gsol ba 'debs// gdos bcas 'od lus yal bar byin gyis rlobs// bde chen 'khor lo lnga yi pho brang du// dus gsum rgyun chad med pa bde ba'i ngang*// ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bde stong zung du 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// rgyal ba'i bstan pa gong du 'phel ba'i zhing*// bka' dang dam tshig gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du// bka' srung dam can rnams la gsol ba 'debs// phyi nang bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// bdag rgyud smin grol chos kyis grol nas kyang*// bskyed rdzogs gnyis la brtan pa rab thob nas// mchog gi dngos grub da lta thob pa ru// byin gyis rlobs shig gu ru rin po che// lam sna drongs shig gu ru rin po che// bar chad sol cig gu ru rin po che// dngos grub stsol cig gu ru rin po che// don gnyis sgrubs shig gu ru rin po che// gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab pa yis// bdag gzhan 'gro ba sems can ma lus rnams// skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i sku brnyes nas// 'gro kun ma lus sangs rgyas thob par shog

/de ltar byin gyis rlobs shig drin can rnams// zhes mos gus drag pos gsol ba gdab par bya'o// sa ma ya/ snying nas gsol ba 'debs mi la// byin rlabs chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab// dag snang can gyi skyes bu la// snang ba bla mar 'char bar nges// zhen log can gyi skyo shas la// bdag 'dzin 'khri ba rtsad nas chod// bdag med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la// re dogs dgra yi 'phrang nas thon// 'chi ba dran pa'i gang zag la// 'jig rten blo sna ngang gis thung*// de kun 'byung bshad zhor byung yin// gang shar la 'dzin pa ma zhugs na// ched du lta ba gnyer mi 'tshal// rat+na gling pa'i 'khyal gtam yin// byin rlabs shin tu che bar gda'// maṅga laṃ// //
